provenance: Author self-review renewing evidence after the Shared nominal-kind revision. Read the complete required authored units, exact selected declarations/implementation/tests and policy; shared identical inputs were read once across packets. Inspected supporting example-state and embedding definitions and evidence helper code in retained source context. Compared statements, assumptions, examples and rejection boundaries with the prose; did not treat hashes, compilation or prior approvals as a substitute for this comparison.
rationale: Comparison for unit:given.patterns against lean:Unique/Unpacking:Pattern, lean:Unique/Unpacking:Statement, lean:Unique/Unpacking:Configuration. Pattern has exactly variable and flat unpack constructors and the extended Statement pairs a pattern with the unchanged Value syntax. The binding rules enforce field coverage, distinct destinations and freshness; the raw syntax intentionally does not enforce those checks. Removal of the container is distinguished from giving a field. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:given.classes, unit:given.syntax.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
